description: Compare what two or more providers offer for a specific data type or concept. For example: 'How do Opta and StatsBomb represent shot events differently?'

providers.description: Providers to compare. If omitted, compares all indexed providers. Use list_providers for indexed keys; common aliases such as ClubElo, football-data.co.uk, engsoccerdata, Sofascore, ESPN, StatsBomb Open Data, Opta F24, WhoScored, SkillCorner, Metrica, Sportec/DFL, TRACAB, Second Spectrum, SportRadar API, Soccer Extended, TheSportsDB, and TSDB are accepted.

topic.description: The concept to compare across providers. Examples: 'shot events', 'coordinate systems', 'xG', 'pass types'

name: compare_providers
